info.title: Tracking System API
info.description: Agency/client access, email/password authentication, invitations, scoped service credentials, numeric email verification, and optional Google sign-in. Facebook sign-in is deferred. Cookie mutations require an allowed Origin and X-CSRF-Token from login or /auth/me.
